note: Generic rules that tell the variants of one function in a game apart (EngineActionChoice, docs/relation-builder.md 'Recommended action'). A rule fits when one of its word sequences is in the action's title or the game's category for it (words compared like the function map: lower case, plural s dropped), or its pattern matches the title; a rule whose words belong to the function itself (trim for 'Pitch trim') does not count. demote: the action is a variant, never the recommended one while a plain action exists. family: actions of another vehicle class are recommended on their own ('for helicopters'). keepsFunction: the variant still is the function (another set or mode of the same control), so the function's general explanation fits it. text: the one-line difference shown under the variant.

rules.text: trim: sets where the control rests, not the control itself
the game's alternate set of this control
used in the game's landing mode
the gyroscope's input, not the main control
for another seat (copilot, gunner or rear seat)
moves the view, not the aircraft
the propeller's blade angle, not the aircraft's attitude
moves the control back to its neutral position
variant marked 'free' by the game; the game does not say what it means

functionTemplates_note: The general explanation (DB/Cockpits/guide/_templates.json) of a function where its name alone picks a wrong one ('Pitch' is no propeller pitch); an empty value: none. Other functions take the template whose words are in the function's name.
